meta.title: FAQ — CARE & OHC
meta.description: Answers about implementation speed, licensing, customization, and integrations for CARE and Care Apps.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.body: Common questions about CARE implementation, licensing, customization, and integrations.

implementation.question: How fast can we implement?
implementation.answer: Implementation timelines depend on scope, integrations, hosting, data migration, training, and governance. OHC focuses on reusable playbooks so deployments do not begin from scratch each time.

ownership.question: What about data ownership and licensing?
ownership.answer: MIT license; governments own code and data; no vendor lock‑in. You have complete control over your infrastructure and data sovereignty with zero ongoing licensing costs.

localization.question: Can we localize forms and terminologies?
localization.answer: Yes—custom EMR forms map to FHIR; BYOT (Bring Your Own Terminology) supported. You can configure local terminologies, forms, and workflows while maintaining FHIR compliance.

nationalPrograms.question: Does CARE support national programs like ABDM?
nationalPrograms.answer: Yes—ABDM workflows can be supported through CARE Apps and integration patterns. Deployment claims should be checked against current program metrics before publication.

monitoringAi.question: Can we add remote monitoring and AI tools?
monitoringAi.answer: Yes—TeleICU (ONVIF), Care Scribe (AI voice fill) are available as Care Apps. AI tools integrate as plugins without modifying the core platform.

security.question: What about security and compliance?
security.answer: CARE implements FHIR R5 compliance with RBAC, audit trails, and sovereign hosting options. Built-in security measures ensure data protection and regulatory compliance.

settings.question: How does CARE handle different healthcare settings?
settings.answer: CARE adapts to various settings—hospitals, clinics, palliative care, veterinary practice. The modular architecture allows customization for different healthcare workflows.

support.question: What support is available for implementation?
support.answer: We provide implementation guides, training materials, and community support. The global developer corps offers technical assistance and best practices sharing.

contact.title: Still have questions?
contact.body: Our team is here to help. Contact us for technical support, implementation guidance, or partnership opportunities.
